title: Senior Software Engineer, Fullstack (Risk Engineering)

business_context.summary: This role exists to build and operate the platforms, APIs, and decisioning systems that support Flex’s risk management as it scales its rent-flexibility product. It sits at the intersection of product engineering and risk operations, helping the company approve legitimate users, stop fraud, and launch new products safely.
business_context.problem_solved: The role helps manage credit risk, fraud risk, and product-launch risk by implementing real-time or near-real-time systems that decide whether users, transactions, or product flows are safe enough to proceed.
evidence: This role exists to build and operate the systems that let Flex make real-time or near-real-time risk decisions around its core product: rent payment flexibility.
That creates credit risk, fraud risk, and product-launch risk that must be managed continuously as the business scales.

The Risk Engineering team appears to be the technical control plane for those decisions: it implements the platforms, APIs, and workflows that decide whether a user, transaction, or product flow is safe enough to proceed.
